profile_text.body:
Meta AI (FAIR) is a for-profit research lab headquartered in Menlo Park, California, whose work is published at ai.meta.com/research. Its site describes the latest from Meta AI research, including a new Meta Model API, and names Muse Image, Muse Spark, Muse Glimmer, SAM 3, and open-source AI models among its output.

The harvested text is mostly a listing of model names and the API, so it gives little detail on what each model does or how the lab positions them beyond presenting them as current research releases.

Litigation exposure for the company is recorded in California, with 281 cases. No individual cases, MCP servers, or separately named products are listed for the lab.
